fields.name: account_number
fields.short: Account number provided by the acquirer.

fields.name: additional_data
fields.short: Arbitrary merchant-specific data related to terminal registration.

fields.name: business_reg_number
fields.short: Merchant business registration number as stated in the company registry.

fields.name: corporateuuid
fields.short: Unique identifier for the corporate entity (UUID format).

fields.name: country
fields.short: Merchant's address: country (must be in 'ISO-3166 ALPHA-3' format).

fields.name: merchant_category_code
fields.short: Merchant category code as defined by the payment network.

fields.name: merchant_email
fields.short: Merchant's email address for receiving notifications.

fields.name: merchant_name
fields.short: The officially incorporated company name of the merchant.

fields.name: packageid
fields.short: Identifier of the package in the TECS processing engine provided by TECS.

fields.name: packageorderuuid
fields.short: Identifier of the registered merchant in the TECS system, provided in the response of the registerNewMerchant call.

fields.name: productid
fields.short: Identifier of the product for which terminal registration is to be performed.

fields.name: productid_acquirer
fields.short: Identifier of the product for which acquiring is enabled.

fields.name: sorting_code
fields.short: Sorting code provided by the acquirer.

fields.name: street
fields.short: Merchant's address: street and house number.

fields.name: terminal_country_code
fields.short: Terminal country code (must be in 'ISO-3166 ALPHA-3' format).

fields.name: terminal_language_code
fields.short: Terminal language code (must be in 'ISO 639-1' format).

fields.name: terminal_location
fields.short: Physical or logical location of the terminal.

fields.name: terminalid
fields.short: TECS terminalid given by Tecs processing engine.

fields.name: terminalid_acquirer
fields.short: Terminal ID as set by the acquirer (optional).

fields.name: user_email
fields.short: Email address of the user acting on behalf of the merchant.

fields.name: user_phone_number
fields.short: Phone number of the user acting on behalf of the merchant.

fields.name: vu_nummer
fields.short: Merchant contract number with the acquirer.

fields.name: web_shop_url
fields.short: URL of the merchant's web shop.
